title: Dative: means and sphere
subtitle: Let the verb and context specify the relation.
overview: The dative may describe the means by which something happens or the sphere in which it is true.
Do not label a dative first and translate later; test “by/with” and “in” against the governing word and context.

items.grc: τῇ γὰρ χάριτί ἐστε σεσῳσμένοι διὰ πίστεως.
items.en: For by grace you have been saved through faith.

items.grc: περιπατοῦμεν διὰ πίστεως, οὐ διὰ εἴδους.
items.en: We walk by faith, not by sight.
